cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Software Sales Engineer to join our team.
You will lead and engage throughout the sales lifecycle from discovering the customer's needs, writing proposals, solution demonstration, architecting solutions, building the customer's trust and leading the proof of concept to gain the technical win.
Your sales focus will be aligned to government, healthcare and education customers. You will also be required to work in collaboration with your direct SE Manager and Regional Sales Directors to contribute to sales strategy and team initiatives that create a pipeline, customer excellence and best practices on technical wins.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Own the solution sales activities within the sales process to gain the technical win and the customers' trust. Participate in solution led sales calls and prospect visits, qualifying the customer's requirements. Gather requirements, develop use cases, and fully understand the client's business needs and constraints. Provide exemplary technical expertise on customer product and solution demonstrations. Create unsolicited solution proposals and ensure it meets or exceeds the customer's requirements and is fit for the intended purpose. Ownership of the technical or solution response to RFIs/RFPs and orchestration of the virtual teams to help deliver a comprehensive consultative response. Present a solution proposal to the customer, demonstrate how we solve the customer's requirements and how this aligns with the customers' outcomes and differentiates from the competition. When required, lead the proof of value (POV) from engagement, ownership of all activities and orchestration, through to completion. Play a pro-active ""Technical Account Management"" role within your target accounts including building a trusted relationship, monitoring/managing customer issues in partnership with support, expand the existing footprint and drive competitive displacements. A mentor for SEs and a team player, sharing best practices, providing feedback to product. Technical account lead for Customer Executive Briefing events. Support customer beta activities and early adopter programs. Participate in the Global Presales Enablement program, through the delivery of formal classroom training. Adhere to corporate guidelines and compliance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Excellent communication skills at technical and business level.
3+ Years of proven cybersecurity experience.
Technical specialist in one of these Technologies: [Product name masked] Solutions & architectures; Cloud and Virtualization security; Data protection and privacy; Network, Web Proxy and SDWAN; Workload and Container security.
Attentive to technical detail to ensure customer bills of material meet their use case requirements.
Preferred Requirements
Industry relevant certification such as AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CEH.
Comfortable presenting and showcasing innovative technologies, solutions and approaches with the market.
Able to understand customer context and capability, and adapt to use cases and improvement opportunities relevant to customers.
Ambitious with appetite to learn.
This role is an excellent opportunity to expand your skillset and exposure to cybersecurity at scale.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Own the solution sales activities within the sales process to gain the technical win and the customers' trust.
Participate in solution-led sales calls and prospect visits, qualifying the customer's requirements.
Gather requirements, develop use cases, and fully understand the client's business needs and constraints.
Provide technical expertise on customer product and solution demonstrations.
Create solution proposals and ensure they meet the customer's requirements and are fit for the intended purpose.
Ownership of the technical or solution response to RFIs/RFPs and coordination of virtual teams to help deliver a comprehensive consultative response.
Document how a proposed solution addresses the customer's requirements, aligns with their outcomes, and differentiates from the competition, and share this with relevant stakeholders.
When required, lead the proof of value (POV) from engagement through to completion, with ownership of all activities and coordination.
Fulfil a Technical Account Management function within target accounts, including building a trusted relationship, monitoring and managing customer issues in coordination with support, expanding the existing footprint, and driving competitive displacements.
Share best practices and provide feedback to product; act as a resource for other SEs.
Serve as technical account lead for Customer Executive Briefing events.
Support customer beta activities and early adopter programs.
Contribute to the Global Presales Enablement program through delivery of formal classroom training.
Adhere to corporate guidelines and compliance.
cond_0178.requirements:
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting at technical and business level.
3+ Years of proven cybersecurity experience.
Technical specialist in one of these technologies: [Product name masked] solutions and architectures; Cloud and Virtualization security; Data protection and privacy; Network, Web Proxy and SDWAN; Workload and Container security.
Expertise validated with industry-relevant certification such as AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, or CEH.
Comfortable presenting and demonstrating technologies and solutions to customers.
Able to understand customer context and capability, and adapt to use cases and improvement opportunities relevant to customers.
Attentive to technical detail to ensure solutions are properly specified and sized, and that customer bills of material meet their use case requirements.
Ambitious with appetite to learn and expand expertise in cybersecurity.

Your sales focus will be aligned to government, healthcare and education customers. cond_0180.intro:

Able to understand customer context and capability, and adapt to use cases and improvement opportunities relevant to customers.

cond_0234.intro:
We are looking for a Software Sales Engineer to join our team.
You will work alongside the sales team throughout the sales lifecycle — from understanding customer needs, writing proposals, and demonstrating solutions, to architecting approaches, building customer trust, and coordinating proof of concept efforts to secure the technical win.
Your sales focus will be aligned to government, healthcare and education customers. You will also work in close collaboration with your direct SE Manager and Regional Sales Directors to contribute to sales strategy and team initiatives that build pipeline, support customer excellence, and share best practices on technical wins.
cond_0234.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the sales team on solution sales activities within the sales process to secure the technical win and build customers' trust.
Participate in solution-led sales calls and prospect visits, working together to qualify customer requirements.
Gather requirements, develop use cases, and work with the team to fully understand the client's business needs and constraints.
Share technical expertise through customer product and solution demonstrations.
Help develop solution proposals and ensure they meet or exceed customer requirements and are fit for purpose.
Support the technical or solution response to RFIs/RFPs and coordinate with virtual teams to deliver a comprehensive consultative response.
Present solution proposals to customers, working together to show how requirements are addressed, outcomes are aligned, and differentiation from competition is clear.
When required, coordinate the proof of value (POV) from engagement through to completion, working with all relevant parties across each stage.
Contribute to a ""Technical Account Management"" approach within target accounts — building trusted relationships, working with support to monitor and manage customer issues, helping expand the existing footprint, and supporting competitive displacements.
Act as a mentor for SEs and share best practices and product feedback with the broader team.
Serve as technical account lead for Customer Executive Briefing events.
Support customer beta activities and early adopter programs.
Participate in the Global Presales Enablement program, including delivery of formal classroom training.
Adhere to corporate guidelines and compliance.
cond_0234.requirements:
Excellent communication skills at technical and business level.
3+ Years of proven cybersecurity experience.
Technical specialist in one of these technologies: [Product name masked] Solutions & architectures; Cloud and Virtualization security; Data protection and privacy; Network, Web Proxy and SDWAN; Workload and Container security.
Expertise validated with industry relevant certification such as AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CEH.

You will lead and engage throughout the sales lifecycle from discovering the customer's needs, writing proposals, solution demonstration, architecting solutions, building the customer's trust and leading the proof of concept to gain the technical win.
Your sales focus will be aligned to government, healthcare and education customers. You will also be required to work in collaboration with your direct SE Manager and Regional Sales Directors to contribute to sales strategy and team initiatives that create a pipeline, customer excellence and best practices on technical wins.
cond_0244.responsibilities: Own the solution sales activities within the sales process to gain the technical win and the customers' trust. Participate in solution led sales calls and prospect visits, qualifying the customer's requirements. Gather requirements, develop use cases, and fully understand the client's business needs and constraints. Provide exemplary technical expertise on customer product and solution demonstrations. Create unsolicited solution proposals and ensure it meets or exceeds the customer's requirements and is fit for the intended purpose. Ownership of the technical or solution response to RFIs/RFPs and orchestration of the virtual teams to help deliver a comprehensive consultative response. Present a solution proposal to the customer, demonstrate how we solve the customer's requirements and how this aligns with the customers' outcomes and differentiates from the competition. When required, lead the proof of value (POV) from engagement, ownership of all activities and orchestration, through to completion. Play a pro-active ""Technical Account Management"" role within your target accounts including building a trusted relationship, monitoring/managing customer issues in partnership with support, expand the existing footprint and drive competitive displacements. A mentor for SEs and a team player, sharing best practices, providing feedback to product. Technical account lead for Customer Executive Briefing events. Support customer beta activities and early adopter programs. Participate in the Global Presales Enablement program, through the delivery of formal classroom training. Adhere to corporate guidelines and compliance.
cond_0244.requirements: Excellent communication skills at technical and business level. 3+ Years of proven cybersecurity experience. Technical specialist in one of these Technologies: [Product name masked] Solutions & architectures; Cloud and Virtualization security; Data protection and privacy; Network, Web Proxy and SDWAN; Workload and Container security. Your expertise is validated with industry relevant certification such as AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CEH. You love presenting and showcasing innovative technologies, solutions and approaches with the market. You will instinctively understand customer context and capability, and be able to adapt to use cases and improvement opportunities relevant to our customers. Solutions need to be properly specified and sized – you will be attentive to technical detail to ensure customer bills of material meet their use case requirements. You are ambitious and have appetite to learn. This role is an excellent opportunity to expand your skillset and exposure to cybersecurity at scale.
cond_0244.values: We value excellence and take pride in delivering strong results. We aim to hold a high standard in our work and in the outcomes we create.
